title: Luxury Car Showroom Lighting Studio
description: The user controls a luxury car showroom where an iridescent designer lamp illuminates a car paint sample panel. Users adjust lamp height, rotation, color temperature, intensity, and panel angle to match a target lighting configuration, then capture a snapshot for client approval.
prompt: Create a single HTML file using Three.js r170 (via importmap from cdn.jsdelivr.net) that implements a luxury car showroom lighting studio. Load IridescenceLamp.glb and ClearCoatCarPaint.glb using GLTFLoader. Place the car paint panel at the center of a dark showroom floor (a large dark gray plane). Position the iridescent lamp above and to the right of the panel. Add a subtle ambient light (intensity 0.15) and a point light parented to the lamp model to simulate it casting light onto the paint panel. Use OrbitControls for camera navigation, starting at position (3, 2.5, 4) looking at the origin. Create an HTML control panel overlay with these interactive controls: (1) a vertical slider for lamp height ranging from 1.0 to 4.0 units, default 2.5; (2) a horizontal slider for lamp orbit angle around the panel from 0 to 360 degrees, default 45; (3) a color temperature slider from 2700K (warm) to 6500K (cool) that maps to RGB values and updates the point light color; (4) an intensity slider from 0.5 to 3.0, default 1.5, controlling the point light intensity; (5) a slider for paint panel tilt angle from -30 to 30 degrees on the X axis, default 0; (6) a dropdown to select one of three environment presets (Dawn, Noon, Midnight) that changes the ambient light color tint and scene background color. Display a target configuration box showing specific values for all six parameters. Add a 'Validate Configuration' button that checks if all current values are within 10% tolerance of the target values. Show green checkmarks next to matching parameters and red crosses next to mismatched ones. When all six parameters match, display a success banner. Add a 'Capture Snapshot' button that only activates after successful validation, which triggers a brief camera animation zooming into the paint panel. Ensure the lamp model casts shadows onto the paint panel using PCFSoftShadowMap. Use requestAnimationFrame for the render loop. Style the UI with a dark semi-transparent sidebar.
